entities.summary: The Al-Aman Bahela Khatun Mosque is a mosque located at Belkuchi, 20 kilometres (12 mi) southeast of Sirajganj in the Rajshahi Division of Bangladesh. The mosque is a traditional mosque built on 50,160 square metres (539,900 sq ft), or 20 and a half bighas, of land on the west side of Sirajganj-Enayetpur road in Mukandganti mahalla of ward 8 of the Belkuchi municipal area.
